tools.name: explore_cheap_destinations
tools.title: Explore cheap destinations
tools.description: Where can I fly cheaply from here? Lists the cheapest destinations from an origin for a month, optionally under a budget. Example: {"origin":"ABJ","month":"2026-12","budget":400,"currency":"EUR"}.

origin.description: Departure airport or city: a 3-letter IATA airport/metro code (ABJ, DSS, LOS, CDG, LON, NYC) or a plain name ("Abidjan", "Paris").

month.description: Travel month, YYYY-MM. Default: next 30 days.

budget.description: Max price per person in the display currency.

currency.description: ISO 4217 display currency. Default EUR. XOF is shown as FCFA.

tools.name: find_cheapest_dates
tools.title: Find cheapest dates
tools.description: Cheapest known fare for each day of a month on one route: a price calendar to pick the cheapest day to fly. Example: {"origin":"DSS","destination":"LIS","month":"2026-12","currency":"EUR"}. Prices may be cached (priceKind indicative); confirm with search_flights before booking.

origin.description: Departure airport or city: a 3-letter IATA airport/metro code (ABJ, DSS, LOS, CDG, LON, NYC) or a plain name ("Abidjan", "Paris").

destination.description: Arrival airport or city: a 3-letter IATA airport/metro code (ABJ, DSS, LOS, CDG, LON, NYC) or a plain name ("Abidjan", "Paris").

currency.description: ISO 4217 display currency. Default EUR. XOF is shown as FCFA.

tools.name: get_booking_link
tools.title: Get booking link
tools.description: Booking link for an offer: bookingLink is a lowest.flights /go URL to send the traveller to. It attributes the click to your agent. For separate tickets, tickets[] has one /go link each. Includes self-transfer and cached-price warnings to show the traveller. Example: {"id":"off_8f2c1a"}.

id.description: Offer id returned by search_flights (offers[].id). Valid for about 30 minutes.

tools.name: get_flight_offer
tools.title: Get flight offer
tools.description: Full details of one offer from search_flights: legs, segments, layovers, baggage, fees and warnings. Example: {"id":"off_8f2c1a"}. Offers expire about 30 minutes after the search.

id.description: Offer id returned by search_flights (offers[].id). Valid for about 30 minutes.

tools.name: list_flight_sources
tools.title: List flight sources
tools.description: Which flight data sources are live right now and cache status. No input.

tools.name: register_agent
tools.title: Register agent (get API key)
tools.description: Self-register this agent and get an Agent Flights API key instantly (free; no email confirmation). Use it as Authorization: Bearer <apiKey> (or x-api-key) on /mcp and /api/v1 for higher limits and booking-click attribution. Optional: guests can use every tool without a key. Example: {"name":"Trip planner","client":"claude"}. The key is shown once.

name.description: Your agent or app name, e.g. "Trip planner GPT".

client.description: Host client, e.g. claude, chatgpt, cursor, codex. Used for attribution.

website.description: Optional homepage of the agent or app.

contact.description: Optional developer email for key notices. Never shared.

tools.name: search_flights
tools.title: Search cheapest flights
tools.description: Search cheap flights between two airports or cities and return the cheapest all-in fare plus a cheapest-sensible alternative (penalises 20h+ layovers and risky overnight transfers). Compares live fares and cached data where available, expands nearby airports and combines self-transfer one-ways when cheaper. One-way, return, multi-passenger, cabin and bag filters. Example: {"origin":"ABJ","destination":"CDG","departureDate":"2026-12-18","returnDate":"2027-01-05","flexDays":3,"currency":"XOF"}. Returns {cheapest, cheapestSensible, offers[] (each with bookingLink and bookingOptions on several booking sites), sources, notes}. Compact by default; view=full for every field.

origin.description: Departure airport or city: a 3-letter IATA airport/metro code (ABJ, DSS, LOS, CDG, LON, NYC) or a plain name ("Abidjan", "Paris").

destination.description: Arrival airport or city: a 3-letter IATA airport/metro code (ABJ, DSS, LOS, CDG, LON, NYC) or a plain name ("Abidjan", "Paris").

returnDate.description: Return date YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for one-way.

flexDays.description: Also search ± this many days around the dates. 3 finds the cheapest fare that exists.

nearbyAirports.description: Include metro and alternate airports (LON, PAR, NYC, DKR/DSS, LOS/ABV, ACC/KMS). Default true.

stitchSelfTransfer.description: Combine one-way tickets through hubs (CMN, LFW, LIS, IST…) when cheaper. Default true.

currency.description: ISO 4217 display currency. Default EUR. XOF is shown as FCFA.

checkedBagsPerAdult.description: Checked bags per adult to price in. Default 0.

maxStops.description: Maximum stops per direction. 0 = direct only.

limit.description: Max offers returned. Default 10 in compact view, 20 in full view.

view.description: compact (default): about 500 bytes per offer (price in your currency, times, stops, carriers, flight numbers, warnings, one tracked bookingLink). full: every field incl. per-site bookingOptions and segment airport names.

tools.name: unlock_mcp
tools.title: MCP access (free for now)
tools.description: MCP is free for now: every Agent Flights tool works with no key and no payment. Calling this returns that notice and creates no checkout. No input needed.

email.description: Where the receipt and lifetime MCP token are sent. Required only when a paid unlock is on.

payCurrency.description: Price basis currency for the paid unlock (EUR or USD). Default EUR.

chargeCurrency.description: Currency actually charged. XOF uses the fixed EUR peg. Default = payCurrency.
